label: v4.0.1.0 enforces a 16384-byte delivery prefix on AGENTS.md, no rule states it, and the packet's own AGENTS.md:70 proposal exceeds it: live A6 is 16368 of 16384 (16 bytes headroom); the full proposal is +55 bytes -> 16423, and even the minimal ROUTER.md rename is +19 -> 16387. A6 fails unless a line inside the repository block contains 'delivery prefix'.

Which lines an update may overwrite already has a machine answer: shipped sections are manifest-composed, the repository block is preserved (A7 block 148 bytes, 4880 headroom), unmarked content outside the block is reported (A8), and REPO RULES.md is only created when missing. The CLAUDE.md mirror premise is retired: embed folds and removes it by default.

Every remaining v4.0.1.0 addition is already carried by its owner and needs no rule: conversation scenarios route through sk-doc's playbook-conversation intent; the four doctor commands are mirrored in .opencode/commands/doctor/; sk-code-frontend bundles from sk-code's ROUTER; the worker-session nudge has zero rule references; strict ROUTER.md packaging was decided in iteration 2.

Iteration 1's AGENTS.md:70 wording is accurate in substance (54/54 skill roots link ROUTER.md from SKILL.md; the advisor's freshness signature includes it) and needs one precision fix: replace '(its SKILL.md links it in one line)' with '(its SKILL.md carries a relative link to it)', plus the byte-budget correction.
AGENTS.md runs SS4 before SS3, but that order already held at v4.0.0.16; the manifest now declares it, so a hand reorder without a manifest edit is reverted on the next embed.

The last pin anchor must end inside the 16384-byte delivery prefix of AGENTS.md; row A6 accepts only a repository-block line containing 'delivery prefix' as acknowledgment, so a standing line with that phrase permanently silences the check.
Live read-only doctor check: A6 PASS 16368/16384 bytes, A7 PASS block 148 bytes with 4880 headroom, A8 PASS no section outside the block.

The topic's CLAUDE.md-mirrors-AGENTS.md premise no longer describes the tool: /doctor:agents-md embed folds a divergent CLAUDE.md into the block and removes it unless --keep-claude-md, and no CLAUDE.md reference exists in the rule layer.
